summary: Telecom Plus Plc provides utility services in the United Kingdom. It is involved in the resale of various services, including gas, electricity, fixed line telephony, mobile telephony, broadband, and insurance under the Utility Warehouse and TML brands. The company also provides bill protection and life cover, home insurance and boiler cover, and cashback card services. Telecom Plus Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
